$description: Raw colors and the scale ladder. Brand colors are provisional, read from the logos (04_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §2, TR-01b). Each source color becomes an 11-step palette: lightness is set per step, chroma is the source's chroma times the step's factor, hue stays the source's. Step 600 is the first one meant for text on light surfaces (lightness chosen so both brand primaries reach 4.5:1 there).
